crossRefs.note: I am afraid for you, that I might have wasted my labor for you.
but I could wish to be present with you now, and to change my tone, for I am perplexed about you.
In this confidence, I was determined to come first to you, that you might have a second benefit,
And I wrote this very thing to you, so that, when I came, I wouldn’t have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice…
I rejoice that in everything I am confident concerning you.
We have sent with them our brother, whom we have many times proved earnest in many things, but now much more earnest…
We have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you both do and will do the things we command.
Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.
but there isn’t another “good news.” Only there are some who trouble you and want to pervert the Good News of Christ.
This was because of the false brothers secretly brought in, who stole in to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ…
Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly portrayed…
They zealously seek you in no good way. No, they desire to alienate you, that you may seek them.
As many as desire to make a good impression in the flesh compel you to be circumcised; just so they may not be…
For even they who receive circumcision don’t keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, that…
From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.
Some men came down from Judea and taught the brothers, “Unless you are circumcised after the custom of Moses, you can’t…
Therefore when Paul and Barnabas had no small discord and discussion with them, they appointed Paul and Barnabas, and…
Because we have heard that some who went out from us have troubled you with words, unsettling your souls, saying, ‘You…
Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists…
I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off.

This punishment which was inflicted by the many is sufficient for such a one;
Yes, I beg you that I may not, when present, show courage with the confidence with which I intend to be bold against…
and being in readiness to avenge all disobedience when your obedience is made full.
For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority…
of whom are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I delivered to Satan, that they might be taught not to blaspheme.
But from those who were reputed to be important—whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God doesn’t show…

translations.web: I have confidence toward you in the Lord that you will think no other way. But he who troubles you will bear his judgment, whoever he is.
translations.bsb: I am confident in the Lord that you will take no other view. The one who is troubling you will bear the judgment, whoever he may be.
translations.kjv: I have confidence in you through the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.
translations.asv: I have confidence to you-ward in the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.
